description: Kill an `fsk_` project API key. Anything using it — a script, a CI job, another agent — stops immediately and it cannot be restored; mint a new key and update the consumer. `confirm` must be the key id exactly, from fillo_list_api_keys. Ask the human first. Needs a LOGIN TOKEN, so a leaked key can never revoke the workspace's other keys.

confirm.description: The exact API key id, typed to authorize this irreversible action. Ask the human to confirm it first — do not fill this in from context on your own.

name: fillo_revoke_api_key
title: Revoke a project API key
